title: The Shallow water by the shore
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：shallow　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shallow 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the director wrote of ① a shallow water by the shore in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② shallower than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the shallow ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the shallowest water by the shore anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too shallow to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the shallow ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a shallow talk about the matter, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as shallow as the talk about the matter they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was shallow or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something shallow, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite shallow; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the shallow ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, on the same day, she wrote of another shallow water by the shore in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ shallower than anybody had expected. ⑩ The shallowest talk about the matter in the whole theatre, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the shallow ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 浅（前置定语 a shallow water by the shore：1988 年导演在戏报里记下的那件浅的水）
B. adj. 浅／肤浅（比较级 shallower than：文中两处，一处比岸边浅浅的水，一处比预想）
C. adj. 浅／肤浅（最高级 the shallowest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 浅（表语 too shallow to do：母亲觉得它太浅，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 肤浅（前置定语 a shallow talk about the matter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩肤浅的议论）
F. adj. 肤浅（同级比较 as shallow as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对事情肤浅的议论相比）
G. adj. 肤浅（后置定语 something shallow：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 肤浅（受程度副词修饰 quite shallow：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a shallow water by the shore
the shallowest water by the shore anybody
a shallow talk about the matter
The shallowest talk about the matter in

answers.why: shallow 意为“浅”，1988 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件浅的水”，此处作前置定语 a shallow water by the shore。
shallow 意为“浅”，此处用比较级 shallower than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
shallow 意为“浅”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最浅的一件，故用最高级 the shallowest water by the shore。
shallow 意为“浅”，母亲认为这件东西“太浅了，谁也用不上”，too shallow to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩肤浅的议论”，此处作前置定语 a shallow talk about the matter。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对事情肤浅的议论一样肤浅”，同级比较用 as shallow as。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，戏报上那半行字要的是“肤浅的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something shallow。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当肤浅”，quite 修饰原级 shallow。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，1998 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要肤浅”，故用比较级 shallower than。
shallow 意为“肤浅”，母亲 2000 年说的是“整个戏院里最肤浅的那一桩”，故用最高级 the shallowest talk about the matter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件浅的水。（a shallow water by the shore）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更浅。（shallower than …）
母亲觉得它太浅，谁也用不上。（too shallow to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩肤浅的议论。（a shallow talk about the matter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对事情肤浅的议论一样肤浅。（as shallow as …）
到了 1995 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件肤浅的东西。（something shallow）
answers: In 1988 the director wrote of a shallow water by the shore in the poster.
Everybody said it was shallower than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too shallow to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a shallow talk about the matter.
He said nobody would call it as shallow as the talk about the matter they had once had.
By 1995 the poster asked for nothing but something shallow.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 shallow 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the director wrote of a shallow water by the shore in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the shallowest water by the shore in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too shallow to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a shallow talk about the matter, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite shallow, and everybody laughed.
The shallow ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
